package.name: sm_coretest_reactor_order_1
package.description: Core test: records whether a state reactor's output event is processed before or after the event that triggered it. A component posts EvX from a node timer on the executor thread; StA has a one-count SrEventCountdown on EvX and transitions on both EvX and the countdown's end to two different states, so the state entered records the queue order.
